cases.text: Сегодня в мастерской тихо. Я проверяю связь и читаю новую команду спокойным голосом.
cases.listen_for: Intelligibility, Kraftwerk reference identity, no foreign phonemes or repeated words.

cases.text: The workshop is quiet today. I am checking the connection and reading the next instruction in a calm voice.
cases.listen_for: English intelligibility and stability; English support is not inferred from completion.

cases.text: Вчера я купил 2 книги за 1250 рублей. Встреча назначена на 21.11.2026 в 14:35.
cases.listen_for: Correct feminine agreement for two books; numbers, date and time are understandable.

cases.text: I bought 2 books for 12.50 dollars on November 21, 2026. The next meeting starts at 14:35.
cases.listen_for: Numbers, date and time; compare actual frontend output, not an invented transcript.

cases.text: МГУ находится в Москве. Инженер проверил USB-порт, GPS и новый процессор.
cases.listen_for: Abbreviations, Russian and Latin letter boundaries, no skipped phrase.

cases.text: The CPU reads data from the USB port. Please check GPS, RAM and the next API request.
cases.listen_for: Acronyms and ordinary surrounding English speech.

cases.text: На горе стоит старый замок. Мастер проверил замок на двери и вернулся в мастерскую.
cases.listen_for: Castle versus lock. No stress accuracy claim before listening.

cases.text: Please record the next message. Keep this record on the desk, and present the present to our guest.
cases.listen_for: Context-sensitive pronunciation; record and present have different roles.

cases.text: Когда погас последний индикатор, инженер ещё раз внимательно осмотрел панель управления. Он проверил кабели, записал показания приборов и попросил напарника повторить короткую команду. За окном шёл дождь, но в мастерской было сухо и спокойно. После небольшой паузы система передала новый отчёт: связь работает, питание стабильно, можно продолжать испытание. Это последняя фраза длинной проверки, и она должна прозвучать полностью.
cases.listen_for: No late stalls, skipped clauses, repetition, early ending or voice drift.

cases.text: After the final indicator went dark, the engineer inspected the control panel once more. She checked every cable, wrote down the readings and asked her colleague to repeat a short instruction. Rain was falling outside, but the workshop remained quiet. A new report arrived: the connection was working, the power was stable and the test could continue. This is the final sentence of the long check, and it must be spoken completely.
cases.listen_for: No late stalls, repeated clauses, truncated ending or English voice drift.

cases.text: Проверка завершена. Дверь закрыта? Да, теперь всё готово! Последнее слово: конец.
cases.listen_for: Questions, phrase boundaries, complete last word and natural unclipped tail.

cases.text: The check is complete. Is the door closed? Yes, everything is ready! The final word is finish.
cases.listen_for: Punctuation, full final word and natural unclipped tail.

cases.text: На горе́ стои́т ста́рый за́мок. Я закры́л замо́к на двери́ и вы́шел во двор.
cases.listen_for: Exact contrasting explicit stresses: за́мок / замо́к; на двери́. RU-stress only.
